party.role: bulky Grass lead; Razor Leaf pressure into Bibarel
fast Flying reserve; Aerial Ace into Sunflora and Dustox
full-health Ponyta pivot; Bulldoze is the verified super-effective line after the opening switch
full-health Steel reserve for Dustox; do not treat Ground moves as an Eelektrik answer
Electric-immune emergency pivot; Snarl is a pressure/debuff fallback, never Bulldoze into verified Levitate
dedicated Levitate counter; Smack Down grounds Eelektrik, then choose a fresh RAM-verified follow-up

target_priorities: Bibarel first: open with Grotle Razor Leaf and repeat it after the verified Super Fang exchange; the live 24-HP remainder is safely finished before switching.
Ponyta: pivot to full Phanpy slot 2 and use Bulldoze; the live samples show a super-effective two-hit line around the Sitrus threshold, so re-evaluate after every acknowledged exchange.

Eelektrik next: preserve and switch to full Rhyhorn slot 5. Resolve live ability first; use Smack Down once as the expected-best Levitate-bypass setup, then obtain a fresh canonical state before choosing Stomp, Horn Attack, a switch to Phanpy for Bulldoze, or the Sandile fallback. Never call the follow-up forced until grounding and damage are observed.
Sunflora: preserve full Staravia, use Aerial Ace before GrassWhistle/Leech Seed, and recompute if the first Energy Ball leaves Staravia below the Dustox survival threshold.
Dustox: use full Cufant as the conservative reserve only when its live HP and incoming Venoshock/Infestation bounds remain survivable; otherwise preserve Staravia for a verified Aerial Ace finish.

opening_turn.action: Razor Leaf, then Razor Leaf if Bibarel remains at 24 HP

contingencies: If Razor Leaf does not damage or is resisted, stop and re-read live types/ability; do not repeat a stale type assumption.
If Bibarel survives the second verified Razor Leaf, stop the line and recompute; do not switch merely because the lead is below half HP when a two-hit KO is proven safe.
Do not queue Ground moves into Eelektrik while live ability is Levitate; its immunity is authoritative and overrides the static type chart.
Do not send Phanpy or Cufant into Eelektrik before the Levitate-bypass state is verified; Rhyhorn's Smack Down is a setup action, not a guaranteed KO.

Rhyhorn's Smack Down is expected-best, not forced: verify that the live target is grounded and that Rhyhorn survives the opponent's acknowledged action. If the survival gate fails, stop and use the fresh state to rebuild the line rather than sacrifice the team.

Sandile's Snarl is only an Electric-immune fallback: it can lower special pressure but does not guarantee a safe line against Toxic/Mega Drain. Verify HP, status, PP, and Eelektrik's ability after every turn before selecting the next action.
If a move confirmation does not leave the move selector, treat it as a tooling defect and stop before battle resolution; never press through a stale selector.
If Toxic, Leech Seed, GrassWhistle, or Infestation lands and no immediate KO is available, pivot to a full-health reserve.
After every queued action, drain battle text and obtain a fresh canonical RAM state before selecting the next action. Any prediction mismatch becomes an incident record before further input.
